I located the duplicate evaluation, but did not edit project source or tests because this run is restricted to fault localization.

`VariableManager.get_vars()` resolves delegation by evaluating loop items in `_get_delegated_vars()` ([manager.py](/app/lib/ansible/vars/manager.py:439)). `TaskExecutor.run()` then calls `_get_loop_items()` again ([task_executor.py](/app/lib/ansible/executor/task_executor.py:109)). Its private loop cache only prevents that second evaluation in some cases ([task_executor.py](/app/lib/ansible/executor/task_executor.py:218)), so a random loop can produce items that differ from those used to prepare delegated variables.

The likely fix spans those files plus [worker.py](/app/lib/ansible/executor/process/worker.py:179), which has a variable manager but does not pass it to `TaskExecutor`, and [task.py](/app/lib/ansible/playbook/task.py:90), which lacks `get_play()`. The behavior to preserve is item-dependent `delegate_to`; the requested pre-loop resolution order leaves its exact handling uncertain. I recorded the trace in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

Updated `TaskExecutor` to resolve delegation before running loop iterations and evaluate loop items once. Item-dependent targets are prepared from that single item list. Added `VariableManager.get_delegated_vars_and_hostname()` and `Task.get_play()`, changed `get_vars()` so delegation is no longer resolved by default, deprecated its legacy delegation path, and removed the loop cache.

Validation: 23 focused unit tests and two delegation integration playbooks passed. A separate loop-control integration test still fails because strategy code strips `_ansible_delegated_vars` from registered results.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [TaskExecutor.run()](/app/lib/ansible/executor/task_executor.py:112) resolves `delegate_to` before evaluating `when`. A task with `delegate_to: '{{ missing_delegate }}'` and `when: false` fails on the undefined variable instead of skipping. Preserve conditional skip behavior while resolving delegation once before loop execution.

- A `/dev/stdin` playbook with undefined `delegate_to` and `when: false` — failed instead of skipping, confirming the defect above.

**TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** None observed. No project code or tests were changed; the review record is in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

Fixed delegation handling in TaskExecutor. An undefined `delegate_to` now waits until after `when` is evaluated, so skipped tasks and loop items skip cleanly. Registered loop results also retain their resolved delegated host.

Verification: 24 unit tests passed, both reviewer integration playbooks passed, and the undefined-delegate skip reproduction passed. No remaining failures or `TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM`.
